vulnerability_analysis.description: Deposed leader C1 in Term 1 presenting unrevoked LeadershipCertificate to lagging storage node N1 at Term 1
vulnerability_analysis.root_cause: Unilateral coordinator key signing on operation tokens without per-mutation majority quorum commitment
vulnerability_analysis.solution_implemented: QuorumMutationPermit requiring explicit Ed25519 signatures from majority quorum (>=2 of 3 voters) bound to exact epoch, commit index, request_id, object_id, shard_id, generation, and payload SHA-256

tests.name: stale_leader_stale_storage_node_rejected_by_permit
tests.scenario: C1 (Term 1) attempts mutation on N1 (Term 1) after quorum advances to Term 2. Single grant presented.
tests.outcome: Storage node rejects mutation with Unauthorized: insufficient quorum permit grants: 1 < required threshold 2

tests.name: stale_leader_updated_storage_node_rejected_fenced
tests.scenario: C1 (Term 3) attempts mutation on N1 (Term 5) with majority permit from Term 3.
tests.outcome: Storage node immediately fences out permit: Fenced { current_epoch: 5, presented_epoch: 3 }

tests.name: fabricated_higher_leadership_term_rejected
tests.scenario: Rogue coordinator fabricates epoch 999 with untrusted signing keys.
tests.outcome: Rejected by cryptographic Ed25519 verification against trusted voter public keys.

tests.name: previously_valid_certificate_replay_without_permit_rejected
tests.scenario: Valid old LeadershipCertificate presented without QuorumMutationPermit.
tests.outcome: Storage node rejects mutation: permit empty grants rejected.

tests.name: delayed_rpc_delivered_after_failover_rejected
tests.scenario: Delayed Term 1 commit index 3 RPC arrives at N1 after Term 2 commit index 5 recorded.
tests.outcome: Rejected by commit index non-monotonicity check (commit_index 3 < highest_seen 5).

tests.name: coordinator_isolated_from_majority_cannot_obtain_permits
tests.scenario: Partitioned leader has access to only 1 of 3 voters.
tests.outcome: Cannot achieve quorum threshold (1 < 2); fails closed.

tests.name: quorum_loss_during_mutation_fails_closed
tests.scenario: Log proposal receives only 1 ack before voter timeout.

tests.name: storage_node_restart_preserves_commit_index_and_generations
tests.scenario: Node restarts from disk; highest commit index (15), epoch (2), and object generations loaded from .rec and .gen files.
tests.outcome: Durable idempotency store preserves executed requests and blocks replays.

tests.name: conflicting_object_generation_updates_rejected
tests.scenario: Permit attempts to regress object generation from 10 to 8.
tests.outcome: Rejected with Unauthorized: generation rollback rejected.

tests.name: repair_operation_during_leadership_transfer_resets_pending
tests.scenario: Repairing job interrupted by failover to new leader.
tests.outcome: Journal crash recovery automatically reconciles Repairing state to Pending.
